placements.why: Several standalone leaves on this document (read order, expand unit, recall oracle, steering/recall separation) concern the design of the frame index as a retrieval architecture, so the org's tier for that design forms here. The name follows the org's own term 'frame index'.
placements.title: From retrieving positions to returning their context
placements.frame: What must the index carry so that a reader receives the context around a position, not the position alone?
consulted: perspective: doors Thematic, People, Dimensions, Documents, Unplaced (0 each)

placements.title: Steering precedes recall and precision
placements.frame: In what order must steering, recall, and precision be applied so that each step's output is read in the context the prior step set?
placements.why: Scarlet's ordering of the read path and the rule that a statement is support for a direction, with a judge seeing a whole position. This is a subject future reads will keep feeding.

placements.title: The unit of expand carries context, not a single position
placements.frame: What must a single expand return so that a reader sees a position within its call or narrative?
placements.why: The navigation shape, the unit of expand, page contents, and the size and spill constraints. The theme recurs as the design is built.

placements.title: Recall is judged against an oracle, not production's placements
placements.frame: What should the judged set say the candidate pool contains, and how is exhaustiveness shown?
placements.why: The method for judging recall, its rejection of production as target, and the measured results as evidence. The measurements support the theme and are not leaves themselves.

placements.title: Steering is ours; recall belongs to an engine
placements.frame: Which parts of this layer are domain judgment the project must own, and which are recall primitives to compose from an existing engine?
placements.why: The ruled split between steering and recall, and the concession that the hand-rolled read layer was the weak link.
Two or more standalone leaves here (reuse of existing work and caps as circuit breakers) concern how the engineering is practised. The org's tier forms for that practice.
placements.title: Build from standing work, and bound the work with tested rules
placements.frame: When a task could be met by extending an existing component, does the work start from that component, and is each new rule tested before it spreads?

placements.title: Adapt the existing component before rolling a new one
placements.frame: Is this build starting from existing work and adapting its specification, or rolling something new inside the constraints as given?
placements.why: The standing rule to take the shoulders-of-giants approach and the ruled rule file, with the build-versus-buy reasoning as support.

placements.title: Output caps guard against runaway output, not ordinary length
placements.frame: Does this cap sit where normal use never reaches it, so that it trips only on runaway output?
placements.why: The argument that caps are safeguards and the ruled rule recording it.

placements.title: Design is tested before it crosses to other sessions
placements.frame: What must a design clear before another session may take it as a build input?
placements.why: The gating of session-scoped design as build input until it is designed and tested.
